question: What is the total revenue from all order items?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items;

question: How many orders are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

question: How many orders are there for each order status?
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What is the total revenue generated by each product category?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Which product categories have the most items sold?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY items_sold DESC;

question: What are the top 10 product categories by revenue?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the total freight cost for each seller?
sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_freight FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_freight DESC;

question: What is the average order item price for each product category?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS average_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY average_price DESC;

question: Which sellers generated the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

question: How many orders were placed in 2018?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01';
